notes.title: Sim Junta is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
From Icehole Games, the makers of WBM Tycoon and World Basketball Manager comes a new statistical management game with a whole new twist!

Have you ever wondered what it might be like to be a dictator? Play the game of dirty politics, make backroom deals with other countries, fight off revolutions and avoid getting assassinated!

Sim Junta is developed as a retro game of the 80's 16-bit computers. It is a statistical management game of brutal and violent politics, since it is a game that has dictatorship as a theme. It is a humorous but very deep strategy game.

Take advantage of the one week release discount!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/390510/
